#include <jni.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <new>
#include <vector>

namespace {
void fail(JNIEnv* env, const char* type, const char* message) {
    if (env->ExceptionCheck()) return;
    jclass clazz = env->FindClass(type);
    if (clazz != nullptr) { env->ThrowNew(clazz, message); env->DeleteLocalRef(clazz); }
}
class Array {
    JNIEnv* env_;
    jintArray array_;
public:
    jint* data;
    jsize size;
    Array(JNIEnv* env, jintArray array) : env_(env), array_(array), data(nullptr), size(0) {
        if (array == nullptr) { fail(env, "java/lang/NullPointerException", "posting"); return; }
        size = env->GetArrayLength(array);
        if (size != 0) data = env->GetIntArrayElements(array, nullptr);
    }
    ~Array() { if (data != nullptr) env_->ReleaseIntArrayElements(array_, data, JNI_ABORT); }
    Array(const Array&) = delete;
    Array& operator=(const Array&) = delete;
};
class Monitor {
    JNIEnv* env_;
    jobject canceled_;
    jobject progress_;
    jmethodID cancel_method_ = nullptr;
    jmethodID progress_method_ = nullptr;
public:
    Monitor(JNIEnv* env, jobject canceled, jobject progress)
        : env_(env), canceled_(canceled), progress_(progress) {
        if (canceled != nullptr) {
            jclass clazz = env->GetObjectClass(canceled);
            if (clazz != nullptr) {
                cancel_method_ = env->GetMethodID(clazz, "getAsBoolean", "()Z");
                env->DeleteLocalRef(clazz);
            }
        }
        if (!env->ExceptionCheck() && progress != nullptr) {
            jclass clazz = env->GetObjectClass(progress);
            if (clazz != nullptr) {
                progress_method_ = env->GetMethodID(clazz, "accept", "(J)V");
                env->DeleteLocalRef(clazz);
            }
        }
    }
    bool check() {
        if (env_->ExceptionCheck()) return false;
        if (canceled_ != nullptr && env_->CallBooleanMethod(canceled_, cancel_method_))
            fail(env_, "java/util/concurrent/CancellationException", "patternizer canceled");
        return !env_->ExceptionCheck();
    }
    bool progress(jlong work) {
        // Match the Java oracle: deliver progress before the final cancellation poll.
        // A pending JNI exception still forbids invoking another Java callback.
        if (env_->ExceptionCheck()) return false;
        if (progress_ != nullptr) env_->CallVoidMethod(progress_, progress_method_, work);
        return check();
    }
};
bool valid(JNIEnv* env, const Array& array, Monitor& monitor) {
    jint previous = -1;
    for (jsize i = 0; i < array.size; i++) {
        if ((i & 4095) == 0 && !monitor.check()) return false;
        if (array.data[i] <= previous) {
            fail(env, "java/lang/IllegalArgumentException", "posting must be sorted unique nonnegative");
            return false;
        }
        previous = array.data[i];
    }
    return true;
}
}
extern "C" JNIEXPORT jint JNICALL
Java_com_synexia_rewrite_pattern_M3PatternizerJoins_abi(JNIEnv*, jclass) { return 1; }

extern "C" JNIEXPORT jintArray JNICALL
Java_com_synexia_rewrite_pattern_M3PatternizerJoins_intersect0(
        JNIEnv* env, jclass, jintArray left, jintArray right, jobject canceled, jobject progress) {
    Monitor monitor(env, canceled, progress);
    // nativeBackend already performs the entry cancellation poll in Java.
    // Preserve callback observations; only guard constructor/JNI failures here.
    if (env->ExceptionCheck()) return nullptr;
    Array a(env, left);
    if (env->ExceptionCheck() || (a.size != 0 && a.data == nullptr)) return nullptr;
    if (!valid(env, a, monitor)) return nullptr;
    Array b(env, right);
    if (env->ExceptionCheck() || (b.size != 0 && b.data == nullptr)) return nullptr;
    if (!valid(env, b, monitor)) return nullptr;
    try {
        std::vector<jint> result;
        result.reserve(static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min(a.size, b.size)));
        jsize i = 0, j = 0;
        jlong work = 0;
        while (i < a.size && j < b.size) {
            if ((work++ & 4095) == 0 && !monitor.check()) return nullptr;
            if (a.data[i] < b.data[j]) ++i;
            else if (a.data[i] > b.data[j]) ++j;
            else { result.push_back(a.data[i++]); ++j; }
        }
        if (!monitor.progress(work)) return nullptr;
        jintArray out = env->NewIntArray(static_cast<jsize>(result.size()));
        if (out != nullptr && !result.empty())
            env->SetIntArrayRegion(out, 0, static_cast<jsize>(result.size()), result.data());
        return env->ExceptionCheck() ? nullptr : out;
    } catch (const std::bad_alloc&) {
        fail(env, "java/lang/OutOfMemoryError", "pattern join allocation");
    } catch (...) {
        fail(env, "java/lang/IllegalStateException", "native pattern join failed");
    }
    return nullptr;
}
